_about: D1b: the power ladder, loaded by sim/core/fighter_data.gd into a LadderDef (f.ld). Power fills by fillPerSec up to 100; each threshold starts the next tier (four tiers until forms, F1). Per tier above 1: free-flight speed, damage and launch force x (1 + value x (tier - 1)). A power-up at ground level damages an area of radius (areaR + tier x areaRPerTier) x WS with damage areaDmg + tier x areaDmgPerTier.
_chargePerSec: power per second while the fighter charges (Q10: it was a constant 9 in the sim; with fillPerSec 0.05 and thresholds 30, 65 and 100 the pace is about three form steps a fighter, the first at about 1:30, spec-wounds section 8b)
_stepKinds: one entry per threshold: a pausing step may pause the fight (sim/core/pause.gd; data/fight/pause.json), a live step never does
_manualTierUp: false: a threshold raises the tier by itself, as before. true: the fighter becomes ready (formReady) and the tier waits for the transform (ADR 0008; the director's placeholder transform switches it on)

reach._note: high-tier structure reach (docs/world/structure-reach.md): the area in which impacts, power-ups, clashes and blasts damage structures grows by tier (the whole blast scales); ringCap is a per-blast cap on buildings levelled beyond the old reach, -1 for none

beam._note: the beam tier gate, per tier 1 to 4 (balance-targets.md section 15): structure multiplies every beam's damage to buildings; levelCapShare is the share of all structures one beam may level (past it they are left at 25% hp); overshoot is the beam's length past its target, in units before WS (the 4,200 x WS total cap stays)
